metadata.description: hi-space's AWS skills for Claude Code and other Agent Skills runtimes: aws-diagram-design (AWS-branded editorial HTML/SVG/PNG diagrams with a Python generator), aws-drawio-diagram (editable draw.io diagrams with a verified stencil catalog), and aws-ppt-master (natively editable PPTX decks with AI images on Amazon Bedrock and a layout/copy-voice QA gate), and aws-tech-blog-writer (AWS Tech Blog posts in Korean house style, fact-checked, delivered as .docx with colour-coded placeholders, plus the aws-blog-review pre-submission review skill), and aws-workshop-studio (hands-on AWS workshop generator in the quick-* VitePress format with standalone aws-fact-check and persona-review skills), plus demo-video-recorder (demo/LinkedIn videos of a web UI with Playwright and ffmpeg: in-page camera, story-scripted captions, highlight reels).

plugins.name: aws-diagram-design
plugins.description: AWS-branded editorial diagrams (27 types) as HTML/SVG/PNG with official AWS Architecture Icons and Amazon Ember; draw.io and Mermaid import; Python generator for ko/en PNG sets.

plugins.name: aws-drawio-diagram
plugins.description: Editable AWS architecture diagrams as draw.io (.drawio) XML. Stencil catalog of 1,000+ names regenerated from draw.io sources, two-pattern icon rule, layout conventions, 5 templates, validator, and SVG image fallback for icons draw.io lacks (Bedrock AgentCore resources).

plugins.name: aws-ppt-master
plugins.description: Natively editable PPTX decks from documents or a topic (ppt-master fork); AI images on Amazon Bedrock only; PPTX layout + Korean copy-voice QA gate; 304 AWS service icons.

plugins.name: aws-tech-blog-writer
plugins.description: AWS Tech Blog (Korean) post writer and reviewer. aws-tech-blog-writer: brief and fact base from the project sources, plan (approval gate), research with diagrams in parallel, the draft written by a fresh subagent from a minimal packet, then a hand-off to aws-blog-review. aws-blog-review: lint, AWS-docs fact-check with currency, and a first-reader story review in parallel, a findings report, one revision pass in the literal house voice (no metaphors, no agentless passives, noun-phrase headings, official names linked at first mention), and a Word (.docx) file named after the post with colour-coded placeholders for what only the author knows. Also reviews a finished draft sent as Markdown or Word.

plugins.name: aws-workshop-studio
plugins.description: Fork of workshop-scaffold 0.2.6, insight-first: generate a complete hands-on AWS workshop (quick-* VitePress site, scenario labs, datasets, persona review, participant walkthrough loop) from a topic, scenarios and target customer, with the architecture rationale (why this architecture, per-service value, before/after) rendered on the overview page and architecture diagrams drawn with aws-diagram-design. Standalone skills aws-fact-check and persona-review; commands /new-workshop, /workshop-check, /workshop-walkthrough.

plugins.name: demo-video-recorder
plugins.description: Demo / LinkedIn videos of a web UI on a headless Linux box: story script first, Playwright wall-clock recording with an in-page CSS camera (crisp zoom-ins), title card and captions burned from beats anchored to UI events, sped-up waits, highlight reel from several clips. Also captions user-made screen recordings (.mov). Not AWS-specific.
